Floette used Light of Ruin → Gyarados

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Blaziken. Lead Whimsicott+Blaziken: turn-one Prankster Tailwind while Mega Blaziken Protects and banks Speed Boost; from turn 2 it outspeeds even Scarf Dragapult (+1 in Tailwind) and sweeps. Prankster Taunt breaks Maushold Follow Me so Annihilape can't hide. Back two: Gengar (Focus Sash Shadow Ball answers Dragapult/Basculegion, resists Fairy for Floette) and Gyarados (Intimidate pivot; Ice Fang for Dragapult, Waterfall for Arcanine-H, Power Whip for Basculegion). Kingambit/Excadr
decisions.notebook: Verified corrections: CC only 2x into Arcanine-H; Annihilape IMMUNE to Close Combat; Knock Off vs Annihilape neutral - Flare Blitz correct. Gengar resists Fairy 0.5x. Calcs: +1 Defiant Annihilape CC vs M-Blaziken ~98-140%; M-Blaziken Flare Blitz vs Annihilape 50-91%; Gyarados Waterfall vs Annihilape 31-57%; Waterfall OHKOs Arcanine-H from 74%+ (4x); Gengar Shadow Ball vs Basculegion 58-106%, vs Dragapult 67-126%; Gyarados Ice Fang 2x vs Dragapult. Speed: Scarf Dragapult 267-319; M-Blaziken outspeeds at +3 naturally or +1 in Tailwind; Adamant Annihilape 110-142 > Adamant Gyarados 103. Items/abilities: Arcanine-H Lum Berry; Annihilape Defiant+Leftovers (never Intimidate into it); Basculegion LO Adaptability, Wave Crash OHKOs Blaziken; Maushold Wide Lens Friend Guard. Series plan (both games): Tailwind mode, Mega Blaziken wincon, Gengar+Gyarados back; Kingambit/Excadrill benched. Game 1 (won): opponent brought Annihilape/Arcanine-H/Basculegion/Floette-Mega, benched Dragapult/Maushold. Tendencies: opponent chains THREE+ consecutive Protects under sustained double-target pressure - their stall hands free Speed Boost turns, so mirror with our own Protects and let boosts compound; Annihilape played purely as CC-into-Blaziken + Protect/Leftovers stall, never Rage Fist/Drain Punch; Floette-Mega played as Fairy Aura nuke. Game-2 expectations: Dragapult likely in for speed control and/or Maushold Follow Me to shield Annihilape - answers: Prankster Taunt breaks Follow Me; Gengar Sash Shadow Ball + Gyarados Ice Fang for Pult; turn-1 Tailwind + Mega Protect banks boost, from turn 2 M-Bla

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Floette. Lead Floette+Arcanine for Fairy Aura + Intimidate turn-one job vs physical/Tailwind leads; back Ape (4x Gambit CC/Rage) + Adapt Bascu (Wave/Jet) complete endgame vs remaining core. Matches G1 answer and avoids dual-Mega conflict.

Prankster Tailwind resolves before any non-priority attack even if Arcanine OHKOs Whimsicott, and Mega Protect banks Speed Boost while both foes' STABs are resisted or blocked. If Whimsicott falls, Gengar enters free under Tailwind with Sludge Bomb for Floette; if they stall with Protects (their habit), our boosts compound for free. Turn 2: +1 M-Blaziken outspeeds everything in Tailwind and CCs Arcanine-H.

decisions.rationale: With Blaziken forced to Pass, the replacement must cover the real wincon-killer: Floette-Mega, whose Light of Ruin can OHKO Blaziken. Gengar threatens 2x Sludge Bomb on Floette, resists Fairy (0.5x) if it eats the nuke, has Sash insurance, and answers Dragapult/Basculegion in back. Gyarados stays reserved as the Arcanine-H/Annihilape answer; bringing it now only chips ES damage and invites a free Floette turn. Next turn: Blaziken CC Arcanine-H (2x) + Gengar Sludge Bomb Floette.

decisions.rationale: Whims has no Protect; FB guarantees KO and removes Prankster support before Tailwind snowballs. Mega LoR pressures Blaziken (Fairy Aura) while it is still -1 Atk; CC still KOes Arcanine so trade Whims for chip/position. Deny free Speed Boost turns.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp physical core Mega Blaziken Speed Boost, Kingambit, Gyarados, Excadrill + Prankster Whimsicott + Gengar Sash. Answer Mega Floette Fairy Aura, Intim H-Arcanine, Adapt Bascu Wave Crash/Jet, Annihilape CC (4x Gambit)+Rage Fist. Opp Whims Timid Sitrus Prankster (Tailwind/Moonblast/Taunt/StunSpore, no Protect); Gengar Timid Sash CursedBody. Gyarados Adamant Wacan Intim IceFang/PowerWhip; Blaziken Jolly Speed Boost Blazikenite. Game1: Whims/Gengar/Blaz/Gyara. Tailwind early; Blaz Protects to stack while Gyara Waterfalls. Pressure Blaziken earlier; avoid Ape Protect-stall vs dual attackers.

decisions.rationale: Blaziken cannot stay unprotected vs Fairy Aura LoR (93-128%, likely OHKO on my wincon) and Protect is only 1/3. Switching to Gyarados preserves Blaziken, resets the -1 Atk, and Intimidates Arcanine; Gyarados survives anything except a direct LoR, and any LoR use + Sludge Bomb (43-89%) + 50% recoil removes Floette. Next turn Tailwind Gyarados (206) Waterfall OHKOs Arcanine (4x) and Gengar (356, Sash) cleans up.

decisions.rationale: We outspeed everything. -1 CC into Arcanine at 74% (72.8-134.1%) is a likely KO, removing one attacker before it moves; Shadow Ball chunks Annihilape 54.8-97.3%. Worst case only Annihilape retaliates: CC cannot OHKO Blaziken (max 94.8%) and Gengar has Sash for Rage Fist. If Arcanine Protects, we still chunk Ape and re-CC next turn with Speed Boost compounded; if Ape Protects, free KO on Arcanine. Down 2v3 we must trade efficiently, not stall.

decisions.rationale: Gengar (356) outspeeds Annihilape, so Shadow Ball KOs it from 34% (54.8-97.3%) before Rage Fist fires, even through Leftovers. Blaziken (500) moves first; -1 CC KOs Arcanine from 74% across most of the range (72.8-134.1%), with only a 1/3 Protect saving it. Best case double KO with Gengar intact; worst case Protect-stall just lets Speed Boost push Blaziken to +2, still outspeeding their entire roster for the endgame.
